test_title: PYST 27: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option (1): KNG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46950e8b15f9d5e25256f81a49bd28cc35a924aeaaac640d645fef5165793ca8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f3705a4e834ed64eb734786d0bfd8ec1e4da1448fc001d944f38ac5e23291da.png] 

**Option (2): PRM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ed6dc38b2f879eb47a0ef8e7630401b53c718347b36fa2784be9cb32470d4c9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35595483c1053b10bfee59ff8e67c4e53e2f67a31fabd5274a86317b3073d52b.png] 

**Option (3): EGB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa0b3d05e7627f6a63b0d9ea508781902a6b765b9a6995f6aa7b7372484609ff.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6246232e5f6748e40022ff814fe6778033a2c4c6d7ffcf95e2e914e74061c54a.png] 

**Option (4): GID**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/893c7e792d40598e90f8efa0f1c76507395be0c58c0b9b67b5da4ecc9a1187d3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d46884560a5091b713f1c8798d72fe942c536ae9f4a163f900ee110f29cc672.png] 

PRM, EGB, and GID all follow the same pattern (+2, -5), while KNG follows a different pattern (+3, -7).

The odd letter-cluster is: **KNG**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
